title: 🔥 I LOVE GOD, BUT I’M STILL STRUGGLING—DID HE FORSAKE ME?
paragraphs:
🔥 I LOVE GOD, BUT I’M STILL STRUGGLING—DID HE FORSAKE ME?
💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, I love God, I serve Him, and I put Him first in my life. But I’m still struggling financially, while others—who don’t even care about God—are living in wealth and comfort. Did God abandon me? Is He punishing me?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many believers feel this way, especially when they see wicked people prospering while they themselves suffer. But the truth will surprise you! God’s plan is bigger than earthly riches, and suffering has a divine purpose!

📖 Psalm 73:3 (KJV)
"For I was envious at the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked."
🚨 EVEN THE PSALMIST STRUGGLED WITH THIS QUESTION—BUT GOD REVEALED THE TRUTH!

✔️ Why does God allow His children to suffer while the wicked prosper?
✔️ Does suffering mean you are abandoned or being punished?
✔️ What does the Bible really say about God’s blessings?
🔥 LET’S BREAK THIS DOWN WITH SCRIPTURE AND TRUTH!
WHAT DOES THE BIBLE SAY ABOUT TRIALS AND SUFFERING?

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, if I’m truly following God, shouldn’t my life be full of blessings? Why am I struggling while others seem to have it easy?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many believers think that following God automatically means a problem-free life, but this is a false expectation. The Bible never says that following Jesus will bring earthly riches and comfort—in fact, it teaches the opposite!

📖 John 16:33 (KJV)
"These things I have spoken unto you, that in me ye might have peace. In the world ye shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world."
🚨 THE TRUTH: SUFFERING IS PART OF THE CHRISTIAN LIFE—BUT IT HAS A PURPOSE!

✔️ Jesus Himself suffered—so why should we expect to escape suffering?
✔️ Every great man and woman of God in Scripture faced hardship before they saw victory.
✔️ God often uses trials to refine us, strengthen our faith, and prepare us for greater things!

📖 1 Peter 4:12-13 (KJV)
"Beloved, think it not strange concerning the fiery trial which is to try you, as though some strange thing happened unto you: But rejoice, inasmuch as ye are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, that, when his glory shall be revealed, ye may be glad also with exceeding joy."
🔥 SUFFERING DOESN’T MEAN GOD ABANDONED YOU—IT MEANS YOU’RE BEING PREPARED FOR GLORY!

✔️ God’s greatest warriors go through the hardest battles.
✔️ Your suffering is NOT a sign of failure—it is a sign that you are in the refining process!
✔️ If you remain faithful, your reward will be far greater than temporary riches!
WHY DO THE WICKED PROSPER WHILE THE RIGHTEOUS STRUGGLE?

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, if God is just, why do people who reject Him seem to be rich and successful while His faithful followers struggle?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Even the prophets and psalmists asked this same question! They saw evil people prospering and wondered why God allowed it. But the Bible gives a clear answer—temporary wealth means nothing if your soul is lost!

📖 Psalm 73:12, 17-19 (KJV)
"Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches… Until I went into the sanctuary of God; then understood I their end. Surely thou didst set them in slippery places: thou castedst them down into destruction."
🚨 THE TRUTH: THE PROSPERITY OF THE WICKED IS AN ILLUSION—THEY ARE STANDING ON SLIPPERY GROUND!

✔️ The riches of the wicked are temporary—they will vanish like smoke!
✔️ Their success does not mean God approves of them—judgment is coming!
✔️ The righteous may suffer now, but their reward is eternal!

📖 Matthew 16:26 (KJV)
"For what is a man profited, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?"
🔥 THE WICKED MAY BE RICH ON EARTH, BUT THEY ARE BANKRUPT IN ETERNITY!

✔️ Would you rather have a few years of earthly riches or an eternity of heavenly rewards?
✔️ Would you trade your soul for temporary wealth?
✔️ The wise choose eternal blessings over temporary success!
WHAT DOES THE BIBLE REALLY SAY ABOUT BLESSINGS?

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, I thought God’s blessings meant financial success and an easy life. If I’m struggling, does that mean I’m not blessed?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people mistakenly believe that blessings = money, success, and comfort. But the Bible teaches something far greater—true blessings are not always material, but eternal!

📖 Proverbs 10:22 (KJV)
"The blessing of the Lord, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it."
🚨 THE TRUTH: GOD’S BLESSINGS ARE NOT JUST MATERIAL—THEY ARE ETERNAL!

✔️ The greatest blessings are spiritual—peace, salvation, wisdom, and eternal life!
✔️ Material blessings can disappear, but spiritual blessings last forever!
✔️ God does bless His people materially, but He does so according to His perfect will and timing!

📖 Ephesians 1:3 (KJV)
"Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ."
🔥 IF YOU HAVE JESUS, YOU ALREADY HAVE THE GREATEST BLESSING!

✔️ Are you rich in faith, wisdom, and righteousness?
✔️ Would you rather have eternal joy or temporary wealth?
✔️ The real question is: Are you storing treasures in heaven or chasing riches that will fade?

📖 Matthew 6:19-20 (KJV)
"Lay not up for yourselves treasures upon earth, where moth and rust doth corrupt, and where thieves break through and steal: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven."
DOES GOD STILL BLESS HIS PEOPLE WITH EARTHLY RICHES?

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, if true blessings are spiritual, does that mean God never blesses His people financially? Should Christians expect to be poor?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! The Bible does not say that Christians must always be poor or that money is evil. What the Bible warns against is the love of money and making wealth our god. God does bless His people materially when it aligns with His will, but He is more concerned with our faith than our finances!

📖 1 Timothy 6:10 (KJV)
"For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows."
🚨 THE TRUTH: GOD BLESSES ACCORDING TO HIS PURPOSE, NOT OUR DESIRES!

✔️ Some believers are given wealth to support God’s Kingdom.
✔️ Others are kept humble so they rely on God rather than riches.
✔️ God provides what we NEED, not always what we WANT!

📖 Philippians 4:19 (KJV)
"But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus."
🔥 IF YOU SEEK GOD FIRST, HE WILL TAKE CARE OF YOUR NEEDS!

✔️ God knows exactly what you need and when you need it.
✔️ Riches can be a blessing OR a test—God gives wealth to those who can handle it wisely.
✔️ True prosperity is having enough to fulfill God’s purpose in your life!

📖 Matthew 6:33 (KJV)
"But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you."
WHAT SHOULD YOU DO WHEN YOU FEEL LIKE GOD IS TESTING YOU?

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, I understand that suffering has a purpose, but how do I stay faithful when I feel like giving up? How do I endure this test?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! When we go through trials, the devil whispers lies—"God has abandoned you!" But this is NOT true! God is with you in the fire, just like He was with Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego! Your struggle is not punishment—it is preparation!

📖 James 1:2-3 (KJV)
"My brethren, count it all joy when ye fall into divers temptations; Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience."
🚨 THE TRUTH: YOUR STRUGGLES ARE BUILDING YOU, NOT BREAKING YOU!

✔️ God is strengthening your faith through trials.
✔️ Testing produces endurance and prepares you for greater blessings.
✔️ Suffering teaches dependence on God, not on material things.

📖 Romans 5:3-4 (KJV)
"And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience; And patience, experience; and experience, hope."
🔥 WHAT TO DO WHEN YOU FEEL LIKE GIVING UP!

✔️ 1️⃣ Keep praying—even when you don’t feel like it!
📖 1 Thessalonians 5:17 (KJV) – "Pray without ceasing."
💡 Lesson: Your prayers don’t need to be perfect—just be real with God!

✔️ 2️⃣ Stay in the Word—your faith is fed by truth!
📖 Romans 10:17 (KJV) – "So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God."
💡 Lesson: The more you meditate on God’s promises, the stronger your faith will grow!

✔️ 3️⃣ Surround yourself with true believers who will uplift you!
📖 Galatians 6:2 (KJV) – "Bear ye one another’s burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ."
💡 Lesson: Stay connected to brothers and sisters in Christ who will encourage and pray for you!

✔️ 4️⃣ Trust in God’s timing—your season of breakthrough is coming!
📖 Psalm 37:7 (KJV) – "Rest in the Lord, and wait patiently for him."
💡 Lesson: God sees your pain, and He will answer in His perfect time!
ORIGINAL LANGUAGE ANALYSIS – WHAT DO THE GREEK AND HEBREW TEXTS REVEAL ABOUT SUFFERING AND BLESSINGS?

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, does the original Bible text reveal anything deeper about trials, suffering, and blessings?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many modern interpretations water down the meaning of biblical words. But when we go back to the original Greek and Hebrew, we discover powerful truths that destroy false teachings and bring deeper understanding!

📖 KEY WORD STUDY #1 – "TRIBULATION" (GREEK: ΘΛΙΨΙΣ – THLIPSIS)
✔️ Used in: John 16:33 – "In the world ye shall have tribulation (thlipsis): but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world."

💡 True Meaning:
👉 "Thlipsis" means pressure, crushing, distress, and oppression. It describes the intense struggles believers will face—but it’s not a sign of God’s absence!
🔥 Jesus didn’t promise an easy life—He promised victory THROUGH trials!

📖 KEY WORD STUDY #2 – "BLESSING" (HEBREW: בְּרָכָה – BERAKAH)
✔️ Used in: Proverbs 10:22 – "The blessing (berakah) of the Lord, it maketh rich, and he addeth no sorrow with it."

💡 True Meaning:
👉 "Berakah" doesn’t only mean material wealth. It means divine favor, empowerment, and spiritual prosperity!
🔥 This proves that biblical blessings are not just about money—they include wisdom, peace, and God’s presence!

📖 KEY WORD STUDY #3 – "PERSEVERANCE" (GREEK: ὙΠΟΜΟΝΗ – HUPOMONĒ)
✔️ Used in: James 1:3 – "Knowing this, that the trying of your faith worketh patience (hupomonē)."

💡 True Meaning:
👉 "Hupomonē" means steadfast endurance under extreme pressure!
🔥 Your trials are not meant to destroy you—they are meant to make you spiritually unshakable!
🚨 THE TRUTH: GOD'S BLESSINGS ARE GREATER THAN MATERIAL WEALTH!

✔️ The trials you face (thlipsis) are part of your preparation!
✔️ The blessings of God (berakah) include much more than money!
✔️ Perseverance (hupomonē) is what separates the true believers from those who fall away!

📖 Romans 8:18 (KJV)
"For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us."
OLD & NEW TESTAMENT CONNECTION – PROPHECY FULFILLED!

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, was it always God’s plan for His people to suffer before receiving blessings? Did Jesus fulfill any Old Testament prophecies about this?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many people think suffering means God has abandoned them, but the Bible has always shown that trials come BEFORE glory! Jesus Himself fulfilled prophecies that prove this truth!

📖 OLD TESTAMENT PROPHECY – THE RIGHTEOUS WILL SUFFER BEFORE GLORY!
✔️ Psalm 34:19 (KJV) – "Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the Lord delivereth him out of them all."
✔️ Isaiah 53:3 (KJV) – "He is despised and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief."

💡 PROPHECY FULFILLMENT IN CHRIST:
📖 Luke 24:26 (KJV) – "Ought not Christ to have suffered these things, and to enter into his glory?"

🔥 Even Jesus had to suffer before receiving His heavenly glory!
✔️ His suffering was NOT a sign of God’s rejection—it was part of the plan!
✔️ In the same way, our suffering does NOT mean God has abandoned us!

📖 THE STORY OF JOB – SUFFERING BEFORE RESTORATION!
✔️ Job lost everything—his wealth, health, and family—yet remained faithful.
✔️ His suffering was NOT a punishment, but a test of faith.
✔️ After remaining faithful, Job was restored with greater blessings!
📖 Job 42:10 (KJV) – "And the Lord turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends: also the Lord gave Job twice as much as he had before."
🔥 THE PATTERN IS CLEAR – GOD’S PEOPLE SUFFER BEFORE RECEIVING GREATER REWARDS!

📖 NEW TESTAMENT PROMISE – ETERNAL REWARD FOR THE FAITHFUL!
✔️ Matthew 5:10 (KJV) – "Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness' sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven."
✔️ Romans 8:17 (KJV) – "If so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together."
🚨 THE TRUTH: SUFFERING FOR CHRIST LEADS TO GREATER GLORY—JUST LIKE JESUS!

✔️ Jesus suffered before His resurrection—so will His followers!
✔️ Job suffered before his restoration—so will believers today!
✔️ God never wastes suffering—it is a setup for something greater!

📖 Revelation 21:4 (KJV)
"And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away."
EXPOSING THE LIES OF THE PROSPERITY GOSPEL – WHY “GOD WANTS YOU RICH” IS A DECEPTION!

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, some preachers say that if I have enough faith, God will make me rich and give me a life of comfort. Is that true?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! The prosperity gospel teaches that if you follow God, He will make you rich and give you an easy life. But this is a LIE from Satan! The Bible never promises wealth to all believers—it promises something far greater: eternal life and spiritual blessings!

📖 1 Timothy 6:9-10 (KJV)
"But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition. For the love of money is the root of all evil."
🚨 THE TRUTH: FAITH IS NOT A GET-RICH-QUICK SCHEME!

✔️ Jesus warned against storing treasures on earth! (Matthew 6:19-21)
✔️ The apostles were poor and persecuted—not wealthy and comfortable! (2 Corinthians 11:23-27)
✔️ Many of the greatest believers in history suffered for their faith!
🔥 THE PROSPERITY GOSPEL CONTRADICTS THE BIBLE!

❌ Lie #1: “If you have enough faith, you’ll never be poor!”
✔️ BIBLICAL TRUTH: Paul was one of the greatest men of faith, yet he suffered hunger and need!
📖 Philippians 4:12 (KJV) – "I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: everywhere and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need."

❌ Lie #2: “Suffering means you lack faith!”
✔️ BIBLICAL TRUTH: Even Jesus suffered! Was He lacking faith?
📖 Isaiah 53:3 (KJV) – "He is despised and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief."

❌ Lie #3: “God wants you to be rich in this life!”
✔️ BIBLICAL TRUTH: Jesus told His followers to expect hardship—not riches!
📖 Luke 9:58 (KJV) – "And Jesus said unto him, Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head."
🚨 THE PROSPERITY GOSPEL LEADS PEOPLE TO TRUST IN MONEY—NOT IN GOD!

✔️ Many people follow Jesus for what they can get, not because they love Him.
✔️ They chase earthly riches instead of eternal treasures.
✔️ The Bible teaches us to be content in all situations!

📖 Hebrews 13:5 (KJV)
"Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee."
🔥 TRUE PROSPERITY IS SPIRITUAL, NOT MATERIAL!
SPIRITUAL WARFARE STRATEGY – HOW TO RESIST THE ENEMY’S LIES AND STAND STRONG IN FAITH!

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, now that I see the truth, how do I fight against the enemy’s lies and stay strong in faith?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! The devil wants you to believe that God has abandoned you, that suffering means failure, and that you need riches to prove God’s favor. But these are all LIES!

📖 Ephesians 6:11 (KJV)
"Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil."
🚨 THE TRUTH: WE ARE IN A SPIRITUAL WAR—AND WE MUST FIGHT BACK!

✔️ Satan’s goal: Make you doubt God’s goodness so you walk away from your faith.
✔️ God’s plan: Use trials to strengthen you so you become unshakable!

🔥 HOW TO RESIST SATAN AND STAY STRONG IN FAITH!
✔️ 1️⃣ REJECT SATAN’S LIES WITH SCRIPTURE!
📖 Matthew 4:4 (KJV) – "Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of God."
💡 Lesson: Jesus fought Satan with Scripture—so must we!

✔️ 2️⃣ PRAY WITHOUT CEASING!
📖 1 Thessalonians 5:17 (KJV) – "Pray without ceasing."
💡 Lesson: Prayer is your direct connection to God—never stop communicating with Him!

✔️ 3️⃣ SURROUND YOURSELF WITH STRONG BELIEVERS!
📖 Ecclesiastes 4:9-10 (KJV) – "Two are better than one... for if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow."
💡 Lesson: Don’t fight alone—find fellow warriors who will lift you up in faith!

✔️ 4️⃣ FIX YOUR EYES ON THE ETERNAL REWARD!
📖 2 Corinthians 4:17 (KJV) – "For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory."
💡 Lesson: Your suffering is temporary—your reward is eternal!
🔥 WHEN YOU STAND STRONG, THE DEVIL FLEES!

📖 James 4:7 (KJV)
"Submit yourselves therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you."
THE WORLD WILL HATE THIS MESSAGE – WHY STANDING FOR TRUTH BRINGS PERSECUTION!

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, why do people mock and attack those who stand for biblical truth? If we’re following God, shouldn’t we be loved and respected?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! Many Christians expect that by following Jesus, they will be loved by the world. But Jesus HIMSELF warned that the world would hate us, reject us, and persecute us—just as they did to Him!

📖 John 15:18-19 (KJV)
"If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you. If ye were of the world, the world would love his own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you."
🚨 THE TRUTH: IF YOU ARE HATED FOR STANDING WITH CHRIST—YOU ARE ON THE RIGHT PATH!

✔️ The world hates biblical truth because it exposes sin! (John 3:19-20)
✔️ Satan uses people to attack those who stand for righteousness! (2 Timothy 3:12)
✔️ If you are being persecuted, it means you are shining God’s light in the darkness! (Matthew 5:10-12)
🔥 EXAMPLES OF THOSE WHO SUFFERED FOR THEIR FAITH!

✔️ Jesus – Hated, mocked, and crucified!
✔️ The Apostles – Beaten, imprisoned, and killed for preaching the Gospel!
✔️ Christians today – Still persecuted worldwide for standing on truth!

📖 Matthew 10:22 (KJV)
"And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake: but he that endureth to the end shall be saved."
🔥 ARE YOU READY TO ENDURE UNTIL THE END?
FINAL CHALLENGE – WILL YOU TRUST GOD THROUGH TRIALS OR GIVE UP?

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, now that I understand why suffering happens, how do I move forward? How can I keep trusting God when life is hard?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! The greatest test of faith is not in times of blessing—but in times of suffering. Will you keep trusting God, or will you let hardship make you turn away?

📖 Job 13:15 (KJV)
"Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him."
🚨 THE TRUTH: FAITH THAT SURVIVES TRIALS IS TRUE FAITH!

✔️ Some people love God only when things go well—but that is not real faith!
✔️ True faith says: ‘Even if I don’t understand, I will still trust God!’
✔️ Your endurance through trials will be rewarded for eternity!

📖 James 1:12 (KJV)
"Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord hath promised to them that love him."
🔥 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?

❌ Doubt God because life is hard?
✔️ Hold on to His promises, knowing your reward is coming?

📖 Romans 8:28 (KJV)
"And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose."

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, now that I see the truth, what should I do next? How can I stay strong when life is difficult?"
🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! This is not just about knowing the truth—it’s about LIVING IT!
🚨 ARE YOU READY TO CHOOSE FAITH OVER FEAR?

📖 2 Corinthians 5:7 (KJV)
"For we walk by faith, not by sight."

✔️ Faith means trusting God even when you don’t see the answers yet!
✔️ Faith means believing that God’s plan is bigger than your current struggle!
✔️ Faith means standing firm, knowing that suffering is temporary, but God’s reward is eternal!

🔥 DECLARE YOUR FAITH!
💬 “I CHOOSE FAITH OVER FEAR!”
📢 TAG 3 FRIENDS who need this encouragement today!
PRAYER OF COMMITMENT & STRENGTH IN CHRIST!
🙏 PRAY THIS WITH ME:

"Heavenly Father, I trust You even in my trials. I know You are with me, and I will not give up. Strengthen my faith, remind me of Your promises, and help me walk by faith and not by sight. I surrender my worries to You and declare that I will remain faithful no matter what. Thank You for Your love, Your guidance, and the eternal reward You have prepared for me. In Jesus' name, Amen!"

📖 Isaiah 41:10 (KJV)
"Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness."
PROOF, SOURCES & BIBLICAL EVIDENCE – EVERY CLAIM BACKED UP!

💭 READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, how do I know this teaching is truly biblical and not just opinion?"

🔥 EXCELLENT QUESTION! The Bible commands us to "prove all things" (1 Thessalonians 5:21) and "rightly divide the word of truth" (2 Timothy 2:15). That’s why we don’t rely on emotions or traditions—we back EVERYTHING with Scripture, history, and undeniable proof!

📖 Psalm 119:160 (KJV)
"Thy word is true from the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments endureth for ever."

🔎 SCRIPTURAL REFERENCES & CONTEXT CHECKS
✔️ John 16:33 – Jesus promised trials but assured us of victory in Him.
✔️ 1 Peter 4:12-13 – Suffering is part of the Christian walk.
✔️ Psalm 73:3, 17-19 – The prosperity of the wicked is temporary.
✔️ Matthew 6:19-20 – Store up treasures in heaven, not on earth.
✔️ Romans 8:28 – God works all things for good to those who love Him.
✔️ Hebrews 13:5 – Be content, for God will never forsake us.

📜 HISTORICAL & THEOLOGICAL SOURCES
🔗 Early Church Fathers on Suffering:
✔️ Tertullian (160–225 AD): "The blood of the martyrs is the seed of the Church."
✔️ Polycarp (69–155 AD): Burned at the stake for refusing to deny Christ, proving that suffering was expected among the faithful.

🔗 Reliable Commentaries & Biblical Studies:
